{{< fa brands canadian-maple-leaf >}} I am a Master of Finance candidate at Haskayne School of Business in the University of Calgary.

{{< fa regular trophy >}} I am currently pursuing the Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA®) charter and the Financial Risk Manager (FRM®) designation.

{{< fa regular graduation-cap >}} I recently completed the Investment Funds in Canada (IFC), the Canadian Securities Course (CSC®), the Investment Management Techniques (IMT®), and Post-Baccalaureate Diploma in Data Analytics and Marketing at Okanagan College (Ranked #1 with GPA of 95%).

{{< fa regular money-bill-trend-up >}} I worked as a Research Officer at [CTS Global Equity Group](https://www.ctsglobalgroup.com/) for 5 years,  
focusing on market sentiment, risk management, and analysis of global equity markets.

{{< fa regular face-smile-beam >}} I enjoy traveling, food and sports.
